title: Compare ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and other AI models — stop juggling AI tabs for $54.97
excerpt: See what other AI models have to say.
content_html:
TL;DR: Compare responses from more than 20 AI models with the ChatPlayground AI Lifetime Subscription (Unlimited Plan), now $54.97 (reg. $619) for early Black Friday.

Credit: ChatPlayground AI

$54.97
$619 Save $564.03

Sometimes the first AI-generated answer isn’t the one you want to keep. ChatPlayground AI lets you put multiple models to the test with the same prompt, all in one window. Its Unlimited lifetime plan is down to $54.97 (reg. $619) for early Black Friday.

One prompt, several ways to answer

The platform lets you enter a prompt once and compare responses from more than 20 AI models side by side. Its supported lineup includes models from ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, and other AI providers. That means less time jumping between browser tabs and more time figuring out which response is actually useful.

That comparison feature can come in handy for writing, coding, brainstorming, and other everyday tasks. Maybe you’re struggling to get the tone of an email just right, or you’re working through a coding problem and want to see a different approach. Having the responses next to each other makes it easier to spot the differences without repeating the same prompt across multiple chats.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

Of course, comparing answers isn’t the only thing you can do. ChatPlayground AI also supports conversations with uploaded PDFs and images, AI image generation, prompt refinement, and saved chat histories. So if you’re working through a lengthy document or experimenting with image prompts, you can do that within the same workspace.

The Unlimited Plan includes unlimited monthly messages subject to a fair-use policy, plus priority support and access to new features and future models. Since it’s a lifetime purchase, you won’t have another monthly subscription to keep track of, although you’ll need to redeem your code within 30 days of purchase.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Formerly $619, you can score the ChatPlayground AI Unlimited Lifetime Plan for $54.97 during this early Black Friday deal.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
